translation.01.en: Hey! How has your day been? 😊

translation.02.en: Pretty good! I loved your recent travel photos.
translation.02.zh: 挺好的！我很喜欢你最近的旅行照片。

translation.03.en: Thank you! I put together a little collection from the coast.
translation.03.zh: 谢谢！我整理了一组海边的小作品。

translation.04.en: A quiet afternoon by the sea 🌊

translation.05.en: Is there another preview from this trip?
translation.05.zh: 这次旅行还有其他预览吗？

translation.06.en: When will the new studio set be ready?
translation.06.zh: 新的工作室照片集什么时候准备好？

seli.ready1.en: Thanks for your patience, {0}. Let me check the collection’s availability before I give you a confirmed date.
seli.ready1.zh: 谢谢你耐心等待，{0}。我先核对这组内容的准备情况，确认后再告诉你准确安排。

seli.ready2.en: I saw your question, {0}. I’ll check the details first and get back to you with an update.
seli.ready2.zh: {0}，我看到你的问题了。让我确认一下进度，再给你可靠的答复。

seli.preview1.en: Happy to chat about it, {0} 😊 Do you prefer coastal scenes or the little behind-the-scenes moments?
seli.preview1.zh: 当然可以聊聊，{0} 😊 你更喜欢这次旅行的海边风景，还是幕后的日常片段？

seli.preview2.en: Glad this trip caught your interest, {0}. Which part would you like to see more of?
seli.preview2.zh: {0}，很开心你对这次旅行感兴趣。你最想先了解哪一部分？

seli.generic1.en: Thanks, {0} 😊 Lovely to hear from you. How is your day going?
seli.generic1.zh: 谢谢你，{0} 😊 很高兴收到你的消息。你今天过得怎么样？

seli.generic2.en: Happy to catch up, {0}. What has been the highlight of your day?
seli.generic2.zh: {0}，很开心和你聊聊。最近有什么让你开心的小事吗？
